data.name: Fast Cables Limited
data.description: Fast Cables Limited (the Company) is a public limited company incorporated in Pakistan on December 29, 2008 under the repealed Companies Ordinance, 1984 (now the Companies Act, 2017) and was listed on Pakistan Stock Exchange on June 10, 2024. The Company is engaged in manufacturing and selling of all types of electric wires, cables, conductors, and LED lighting business.
